title: Pointwise finite-stage normalization bridge for the common projection tensor square
statement: For fixed rational inputs M and N, assume the canonical common pullback/tensor comparison has its finite-stage representative at E. Then the left and right composites in the pointwise ComparisonCompatible equation are equal.

source.place: Compatibility: expand the finite-stage representative and cancel the transition and scalar-unit maps for one pair of inputs.

proof.text: Use normalized pullback descent to choose the literal stage-system pullback model. Transport the supplied common comparison through the recorded tensor and pullback equalities. The supplied coefficient comparison has identity components, and the supplied tensorators agree heterogeneously with the canonical inclusion tensorators. Apply the generic component-normalization theorem.

The supplied tensor/pullback normalization and the assumed representative equation give the finite representative for the transported comparison. Apply the proved finite-model square and cancel the identity components of the stage-system inclusion comparison.

proof_origin.place: Compatibility: normalize supplied operations and prove finite-model square by stage coherence, tensor naturality and scalar units.

mathlib_searches.results: The named finite-stage normalization declarations are the only component-level inputs; no exact cancellation theorem exists.

theorem projectionTensorComparisonCompatible_component_of_representative_formula
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    (H : SixFunctorCommonStages D C) (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields C.l C.Qbar)
    (Q : SixFunctorCompactifiedSquare D)
    [hZ : ∀ x : Q.Z.obj.left, Invertible (C.l : Q.Z.obj.left.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ x : Q.Y.obj.left, Invertible (C.l : Q.Y.obj.left.residueField x)]
    (M N : sfRationalConstructibleCategory C.l
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient C.l C.Qbar E) Q.Y.obj.left)
    (hrep : HEq (canonicalCommonStagePullbackTensor C.l C.Qbar Q.p.hom.left
        ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
          (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj M)
        ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
          (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj N)).hom
      (ofHom (commonStagePullbackObject C.l C.Qbar Q.p.hom.left
          (commonStageTensorObject C.l C.Qbar Q.Y.obj.left
            ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
              (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj M)
            ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
              (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj N)))
        (commonStageTensorObject C.l C.Qbar Q.Z.obj.left
          (commonStagePullbackObject C.l C.Qbar Q.p.hom.left
            ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
              (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj M))
          (commonStagePullbackObject C.l C.Qbar Q.p.hom.left
            ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
              (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj N)))
        E (by
          change E.val ⊔ E.val ≤ E.val
          exact sup_le le_rfl le_rfl)
        (by
          change E.val ⊔ E.val ≤ E.val
          exact sup_le le_rfl le_rfl)
        (pullbackTensorAtCommonStage C.l C.Qbar Q.p.hom.left
          ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
            (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj M)
          ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
            (Y := Q.Y.obj.left) E).obj N) E (by
            change E.val ⊔ E.val ≤ E.val
            exact sup_le le_rfl le_rfl)).hom)) :
    projectionTensorComparisonComponent (inclusion E) (inclusion E)
      (projectionPullbackTensor ((H.coefficientStages E).rationalExchange Q)).hom
      (projectionPullbackTensor (H.commonStageExchange Q)).hom
      ((H.commonStageComparison E).directAdjunction Q.p).left
      (projectionCurriedTensorComparison (inclusion E)
        ((H.coefficientStages E).rationalTensor Q.Y) (H.commonStageTensor Q.Y)
        (commonProjectionTensorComparison H E Q.Y))
      (projectionCurriedTensorComparison (inclusion E)
        ((H.coefficientStages E).rationalTensor Q.Z) (H.commonStageTensor Q.Z)
        (commonProjectionTensorComparison H E Q.Z)) M N
